net_assessment:
**THE LANE'S CORE FINDING SURVIVES ADVERSARIAL REVIEW INTACT, AND ITS KEY GEOMETRY DOES NOT.**

Confirmed unchanged: the stink tower is the ONLY one of the 19 entries in `ALL_BLUEPRINT_IDS` (src/state/blueprints.ts:365-391 — 6 t3 + 6 t9 covered by `towerRenderer`, 5 `RAMP_SPECS` covered by `structureRampRenderer`, `voltkin` by its own renderer) whose shapes are still visible under its building. Three production `markTowerCover` sites exist and `stinkTowerRenderer.ts` is none of them. The fix is renderer-only, PROTOCOL_VERSION stays 47, no `GameEffect`, no four-sites obligation, and the art already ships. On the owner's money rule the report is right and I could not refute it: the publish API takes ids and a tick, so there is genuinely nothing to buy. 16 of 18 evidence claims verified verbatim at the cited line; the two that did not are a line-number slip (healthBar :361 -> :364) and one real refutation.

**THE REFUTATION IS THE HIT BOX, AND IT IS THE S182 LESSON FIRING EXACTLY ON SCHEDULE.** The report names the foot-anchored box as "the one thing most likely to be got wrong" and then hands over a width measured from 3 of 12 frames. Full decode: idle union is x 22-206 (W=185), not x 51-202 (W=152), and it is 13.5 cell px off-centre, not "centred to within 1 px". The attack row reaches x 1-253 and is never mentioned. A branch that obeys the report's own instruction — "Re-measure with a decode, never eyeball" — will produce a number that contradicts the constant it was told to write, in the docblock that is supposed to be the audit trail. This is not a wrong conclusion; it is a correct conclusion with a fabricated-precision derivation, which in this repo is worse, because canon.test.ts-style pinning turns a measured constant into a load-bearing fact.

**SECOND-ORDER: A SOURCE-TEXT GUARD WILL BITE THE FIX ITSELF.** `towerCover.test.ts`'s publish census uses `renderSource` (raw, comments included) while the rest of that file uses the comment-stripped `codeOf`. The three existing publishers pass only because their prose happens to write `markTowerCover` without a paren. The report instructs the branch to write a docblock. That is a red test for a reason no one will guess — and it is precisely S182 §2's point restated: the guard proves a line exists, and it counts prose while doing it.

**ONE CONSEQUENCE THE REPORT UNDER-REPORTS, WITH A FREE FIX.** R183-E's wording rests on "you can see it crumble and fall". The stink atlas has two rows, idle and attack — no death row — and `StinkTowerRenderer` has no ghost. After this lands, the tower's sprite vanishes in one frame and its shapes fade back in over a second with nothing explaining it. The report flags the damage signal and not the death signal. It does not break the ruling, but it is the sentence the owner should hear before he plays it — and a purely procedural tint/alpha/drop on the sprite already in scope closes it for zero spend.
